Rashi on Nazir 14b:1:1.hebrew: נטמא בימי צרעתו - היה נזיר ונצטרע, ובימי צרעתו נטמא למתים:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:1:1.english: [If] he became impure during the days of his leprosy - He was a nazirite and contracted leprosy, and during the days of his leprosy he became impure from a corpse:

Rashi on Nazir 14b:1:2.hebrew: ר' יוחנן אמר סותר - את הקודמין, דהא אכתי קאי בנזירות, הואיל דכי נתרפא מצרעתו משלים מה שכבר מנה קודם שנצטרע:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:1:2.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan says: [It] negates - [It negates] the preceding [days], for he still stands in [his] naziriteship, since when he is healed of his leprosy, he completes what he already counted before he contracted leprosy.

Rashi on Nazir 14b:1:3.hebrew: ריש לקיש אמר אינו סותר - דימי צרעת לחוד, הואיל ואין עולין לו למנין ימי נזרו. והימ"ן שונה להני תרתי דרבי יוחנן וריש לקיש בטעמא אחרינא, ואף המור"ה חז"ר להיו"ת כדבר"י הימ"ן: דבין כי נטמא בצרעתו ובין בנזירות בנו — דההוא אידך נזירות נזיר מאה מיירי, לפי שלא מצינו גידול פחות משלשים, והואיל ובתרוייהו צריך לגלח, דלכי נתרפא מצרעתו נמי צריך לגלח — הילכך לא מיתוקם אלא בנזירות מאה:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:1:3.english: Reish Lakish says: It does not negate - For the days of leprosy are discrete, since they do not count for him toward the tally of the days of his naziriteship. And H.Y.M.N. teaches these two [disputes] between Rabbi Yoḥanan and Reish Lakish with a different rationale, and even the Teacher [Rashi] retracted [his view] to agree with the words of H.Y.M.N.: that whether he became impure during his leprosy or during the naziriteship for his son, that that other naziriteship is dealing with a nazirite of one hundred [days], because we do not find [a requirement of] hair growth [of] less than thirty [days]; and since in both of them he must shave — for when he is healed from his leprosy he must also shave — therefore, it can only be established with a naziriteship of one hundred [days].

Rashi on Nazir 14b:5:1.hebrew: נטמא ביום גידול שער - כגון שקיבל עליו נזירות מאה יום, וכי מנה שבעים נצטרע, וכי נטהר גילח תגלחת לצרעת, ואכתי פשו מן המאה שלשים יום, דאית בהו גידול שיער. ונטמא ביום גידול שער — היינו ביום מאה, שבו שלם גידול שיער שלו. דברי הכל סותר השלשים שאחר הצרעת, אבל באם סותר שבעים שלפני הצרעת — פליגי:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:5:1.english: [If] he became impure on the day of hair growth - For example, where he took upon himself a naziriteship of one hundred days, and when he had counted seventy [days] he contracted leprosy, and when he was purified he shaved the shaving for leprosy, and there still remained thirty days of the one hundred, in which there is [sufficient] hair growth. And "became impure on the day of hair growth" — that is, on the hundredth day, on which his hair growth was completed. Everyone agrees [that] it negates the thirty [days] after the leprosy, but they disagree as to whether it negates the seventy [days] prior to the leprosy.

Rashi on Nazir 14b:5:2.hebrew: רב אומר אינו סותר - דאפי' לרבי יוחנן דאמר נטמא בימי בנו דסותר כל נזירות — התם בנזירות קאי, להכי מצי סתר לנזירות נמי. אבל הכא, כיון דנטמא ביום מישלם גידול שיער, כבר שילם נזירותו, ולית ליה כח למסתר דלפני צרעת:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:5:2.english: Rav says: He does not negate - For even according to Rabbi Yoḥanan, who said that [if one] became impure during the days of his son['s naziriteship], he negates the entire naziriteship — there he is standing in [the midst of] naziriteship, which is why it can negate the [first] naziriteship as well. But here, since he became impure on the day of the completion of [the period of] hair growth, he has already completed his naziriteship, and [the impurity] does not have the power to negate [the days counted] prior to the leprosy.

Rashi on Nazir 14b:6:1.hebrew: ושמואל אמר סותר - את הכל, אפי' ע' קמאי:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:6:1.english: And Shmuel said: [It] negates - Everything, even the first seventy [days].

Rashi on Nazir 14b:6:2.hebrew: שם נזירות אחת היא - [אבל] מנין שלו ומנין של בנו תרי נזירות מיתקרו. ל"א: נטמא ביום גידול — כגון דאמר: "הריני נזיר", והתחיל ומנה עד עשרים יום, ונטמא וסתר את הכל, והתחיל למנות נזירות אחרת, ומנה עשרה ימים בטהרה, ואח"כ נטמא באחד מכל עשרים יום הנותרין להשלים לנזירות:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:6:2.english: It is the status of one naziriteship - [However,] his counting and the counting for his son are called two [distinct] terms of naziriteship. Another version: “He became impure on the day of hair growth” — for example, where one said: “I hereby become a nazirite,” and he began and counted up to twenty days, and became impure and negated everything, and began to count another naziriteship and counted ten days in purity, and afterward became impure on one of all the twenty days remaining to complete the naziriteship.

Rashi on Nazir 14b:6:3.hebrew: רב אמר אינו סותר - הללו עשרה, דאפילו לרבי יוחנן דאמר סותר, הני מילי היכא דקאי בנזירות גמור. אבל האי, דלא איטמי אלא בימי גידול שיער דמשלם נזירות הוא — דלכי מצרפי הני עשרה לעשרים קמאי הוו להו שלשים — והלכך, האי דאהדר איטמי מעשרה ואילך לא הוי אלא תשלומי נזירות, ואפי' ר' יוחנן מודה דאינו סותר להנך עשרה; אלא כיון דהזה שלישי ושביעי, מתחיל למנות מעשרה ואילך עד שלשים:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:6:3.english: Rav said: It does not negate - [It does not negate] these ten [days]. For even according to Rabbi Yoḥanan, who says [that impurity] negates [the prior days], this applies only where one stands in full naziriteship. But this one, who became impure only during the days of hair growth, which is [merely] completing the naziriteship — for when you combine these ten with the first twenty, they total thirty; and therefore, his becoming impure again from the tenth [day] onward was only [during] the completion of the naziriteship — even Rabbi Yoḥanan concedes that it does not negate those ten [days]. Rather, once he has been sprinkled on the third and seventh [days], he begins counting from ten onward until thirty.

Rashi on Nazir 14b:6:4.hebrew: ושמואל אמר סותר אפילו לר"ל כו' - אבל הכא חדא נזירות. והא דאמרינן "מישלם נזירות הוא" — לא איריא, דכיון דסתרו הראשונים, שוב אי אתה יכול לצרף עמהן הללו ולומר שלשים הן:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:6:4.english: And Shmuel said: It negates, even according to Reish Lakish, etc. - But here, it is one naziriteship. And as for that which we say, "[It is merely] completing the naziriteship" — that is not a valid argument, for since the first [days] were negated, you can no longer combine these [days] with them and say that they are thirty.

Rashi on Nazir 14b:7:1.hebrew: הכל מודים שאם קידש שיער בדם - ביום ל"א צריך להביא קרבנותיו ולהתגלח אחר קרבנותיו. אם כבר נזרק הדם כשנטמא ועדיין לא גילח — שאין לו תקנה להתירו, כיון דלמנות פעם אחרת ולהביא קרבן אחר אי אפשר, דקרבן אחד הוא מביא ולא שני קרבנות, וכבר הביא קרבן אחד ואין עולה לו דהא כבר נטמא — לפיכך אין לו תקנה. והא דקתני ״קידש״ — לישנא דקרא נקיט, דכתיב: ״וקדש את ראשו״ (במדבר ו׳:י״א):
Rashi on Nazir 14b:7:1.english: All concede that if the hair was consecrated by the blood - On the thirty-first day, [the nazirite] must bring his offerings and shave after his offerings. If the blood had already been sprinkled when he became impure, and he had not yet shaved — [all concede] that he has no remedy to permit him, since to count [the days of naziriteship] another time and bring another offering is impossible, for he brings one offering and not two offerings; and he already brought one offering, and it does not count for him because he already became impure — therefore, he has no remedy. And as for that which [the statement] teaches, "consecrated" — it adopts the language of the verse, as it is written: "And he shall sanctify his head" (Numbers 6:11).

Rashi on Nazir 14b:8:1.hebrew: כיון דאמר תגלחת מעכבת - לשתות ביין, בתוך מלאת קרינא ביה — לסתור מה שמנה, ולייתי קרבן אחר:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:8:1.english: Since he said that shaving is indispensable - [To permit him] to drink wine, [so] we apply to him [the status of being] within the completion [of his days] — to negate what he counted, and let him bring another offering.

Rashi on Nazir 14b:8:2.hebrew: אלא אליבא דרבנן - דפליגי עליה בפרק ג' מינין (לקמן נזיר דף מז.), ואמרי: כיון שזרק עליו אחד מן הדמים, נטהר:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:8:2.english: Rather, in accordance with [the opinion of] the Rabbis - Who disagree with him in the chapter [entitled] Sheloshah Minim (below, Nazir 47a), and say: Once [the priest] has sprinkled the blood of one [of the offerings] on his behalf, he has become purified.

Rashi on Nazir 14b:8:3.hebrew: למצות גילוח - דלא יהא תגלחת בטהרה כמצותו לעולם, שהרי אינו יכול לסתור ולמנות נזירות אחרת, שהרי לאחר מלאת נטמא. הילכך, אין לו תקנה לגלח בטהרה, אלא מגלח בטומאה:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:8:3.english: For the mitzva of shaving - That there will never be a shaving in purity according to its mitzva, for he cannot negate [his term] and count another naziriteship, since he became impure after the completion [of his term]. Therefore, he has no remedy to shave in purity; rather, he shaves in impurity.

Rashi on Nazir 14b:9:1.hebrew: נזיר שכלו לו - ימי שלשים נזירות סתם, ולנזירות מרובה — כל ימים שהזיר. ולאחר מלאת, שצריך להביא קרבנותיו, נטמא — לוקה על הטומאה. "ואינו לוקה על התגלחת" — אבל אינו לוקה אם גלח קודם שהביא קרבנותיו, או שתה יין קודם שהביא קרבנותיו:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:9:1.english: A nazirite whose [days] are completed - [That is,] the thirty days of an unspecified naziriteship, and for a longer naziriteship, all the days that he consecrated. And after the completion [of his term], when he must bring his offerings, [if] he became impure, he is flogged for the impurity. “And he is not flogged for shaving” — but he is not flogged if he shaved before bringing his offerings, or drank wine before bringing his offerings.

Rashi on Nazir 14b:9:2.hebrew: דאמר קרא כל ימי הזירו לה' - דכתיב "כל" דלא צריך, וכתביה, ואמר: "כל ימי הזירו לה' על נפש מת לא יבא" — לרבות ימים כו'. "כל ימי נדר נזרו תער" וגו', "כל ימי נזרו מכל אשר יעשה מגפן היין" וגו' — ולילקי נמי אתרוייהו:
Rashi on Nazir 14b:9:2.english: As the verse states: “All the days that he has consecrated himself unto the Lord” - For “all” is written, which is not necessary, and [the verse] wrote it and said: “All the days that he has consecrated himself unto the Lord, [he shall not come near to a dead body],” to include the days [after the completion of his term like the days before completion]. [Yet it also says:] “All the days of his vow of naziriteship, [no] razor [shall come upon his head]...” and “All the days of his naziriteship, from anything that is made of the grapevine...”; so let him be flogged for both of them as well!

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:1:1.hebrew: נטמא בימי צרעתו - אמר: "הריני נזיר מהיום", והתחיל למנות נזירות — [שימי] חלוטו אינו עולה לנזירות וגם אינו סותר, כדלקמן בפרק מי שאמר (נזיר דף יז:) — ונטמא במת בימי חלוטו: לר"ל, אינו סותר הימים הראשונים שמנה לנזירותו קודם ימי צרעתו; וכשיטהר מצרעתו, יגלח ויביא קרבנות מצורע, ויחזור וישלים מנין נזירות כמו שפסק. ור' יוחנן אומר: סותר, דהא בנזירות קאי ועדיין לא מנה המאה; ולכשיטהר מצרעתו, צריך למנות כל ימי נזירותו:
Tosafot on Nazir 14b:1:1.english: "He became impure during the days of his leprosy" - [If] he said, "I am hereby a nazirite from today," and began counting [his] naziriteship — for the days of his confirmed leprosy do not count toward naziriteship, nor do they negate [prior days], as [stated] below in the chapter [entitled] "Mi She'amar" (Nazir 17b) — and he became impure from a corpse during the days of his confirmed leprosy: According to Reish Lakish, it does not negate the initial days that he counted for his naziriteship prior to the days of his leprosy; and when he is purified from his leprosy, he shall shave and bring the offerings of a leper, and return and complete the tally of naziriteship as he stipulated. But Rabbi Yoḥanan says: It negates [them], for he remains in [a state of] naziriteship, and he has not yet counted the hundred [days]; and when he is purified from his leprosy, he must count all the days of his naziriteship.

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:3:1.english: "And it is necessary" - To teach us their dispute [both] in [the case of] his son and in [the case of] his leprosy.

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:5:1.hebrew: נטמא ביום גידול שיער - פי': אמר "הריני נזיר שלשים יום", וכשמנה כ' מנזירותו גילחוהו ליסטים על כרחו — דהשתא לא יוכל לגלח ביום שלשים לנזירות ולהביא קרבנותיו עד אחר שלשים יום מיום שגילחוהו הליסטים, דאין גידול פחות משלשים יום. והתחיל הל', וכשמנה עשרה סיים נזירותו, שהרי תחילה מנה עשרים טרם שגילחוהו הליסטים; ואלו העשרים יום האחרונים אינם רק לגדל שיער שיוכל לגלח אחר נזירותו ולהביא קרבנותיו, ובהם נטמא. והאי דנקט "ביום גידול שיער" ולא נקט "בימי" כדנקט לעיל "בימי צרעתו" — לפי [שאי] אפשר שלא יהו נמשכים ימי צרעתו טפי מיום אחד, אבל גידול שיער אפשר שלא יאריך עליו אלא יום אחד, כגון שגילחוהו ליסטים יום שני לנזירותו, דהשתא אינו מוסיף על שלשים אלא יום שלבסוף בעבור גידול שיער:
Tosafot on Nazir 14b:5:1.english: He became impure on the day of hair growth - Explanation: [A case where] one said, “I am hereby a nazirite for thirty days,” and when he counted twenty [days] of his naziriteship, bandits shaved him against his will, so that now he cannot shave on the thirtieth day of his naziriteship and bring his offerings until thirty days after the day the bandits shaved him, as [a period of] hair growth is not less than thirty days. And he began the thirty [days], and when he counted ten [of them], he completed his naziriteship, for he had initially counted twenty before the bandits shaved him; and these last twenty days are only to grow hair so that he will be able to shave after his naziriteship and bring his offerings, and during them he became impure. And that which [the text] formulated, “on the day of hair growth,” and did not formulate, “during the days of [hair growth],” as it formulated above, “during the days of his leprosy” — [this is] because it is impossible that the days of his leprosy would not extend more than one day, whereas hair growth can possibly extend for him [by] only one day, such as where bandits shaved him on the second day of his naziriteship, where now he adds to the thirty [days] only the day at the end for the sake of hair growth.

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:6:1.hebrew: התם שני נזירות - של בנו ושלו. וכן נטמא בימי צרעתו — נזירות לחוד וצרעת לחוד. הכא חדא נזירות הוא, וכן נטמא ביום שהוא טהור — חד נזירות הוא:
Tosafot on Nazir 14b:6:1.english: "There [it is] two terms of naziriteship" - [The naziriteship] of his son and [the naziriteship] of his own. And similarly, [in the case where] he became impure during the days of his leprosy, naziriteship is discrete and leprosy is discrete. [Whereas] here, it is one naziriteship; and similarly, [since] he became impure on a day that he is pure, it is one naziriteship.

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:7:1.hebrew: אמר רב חסדא הכל מודים שאם קידש שיער בדם - פירוש: אם לאחר שנזרק הדם נטמא קודם שגילח. וקורא "קידוש שיער" שלא גילח, כדכתיב: "וקידש ראשו", שפירושו: יתחיל לגדל ראשו:
Tosafot on Nazir 14b:7:1.english: Rav Ḥisda said: All concede that if the hair was consecrated with the blood - Explanation: If, after the blood was sprinkled, he became ritually impure before he shaved. And [Rav Ḥisda] calls [the fact] that he did not shave "sanctification of hair," as it is written: "And he shall sanctify his head" [Numbers 6:11], whose meaning is: he shall begin to grow [the hair of] his head.

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:7:2.hebrew: אין לו תקנה - קס"ד שלא יוכל עולמית לשתות ביין ולגלח, כיון שהביא כבר קרבנותיו, וכיון דנטמא קודם שגילח — ובלא הבאת קרבן לא יוכל לגלח:
Tosafot on Nazir 14b:7:2.english: "He has no remedy" - [The Gemara's] initial assumption is that he will never be able to drink wine or shave, since he already brought his offerings, and since he became impure before he shaved — and without bringing an offering he cannot shave.

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:8:1.hebrew: אליבא [דמאן] אי אליבא דר' אליעזר כיון דאמר תגלחת מעכבו - לשתות יין. "תוך מלאת הוא" — כלומר: הרי הוא כאילו נטמא קודם הבאת קרבנותיו, שהוא בתוך מלאת. "ולסתור" — כלומר: יחזור ויביא קרבנות, כדתנן פרק ג' מינין (לקמן נזיר דף מז.): "מי שנזרק עליו אחד מן הדמים ונטמא, ר' אליעזר אומר: סותר את הכל". ופריך בגמרא: "והאמר ר' אליעזר: כל אחר מלאת [שבעה] סותר?", ומשני: "מאי סותר? קרבנותיו, ולאחר [שיטהר] יביא קרבנותיו". והאי "יסתור" דהכא, ע"כ לאו דווקא דנטמא ביום שלשים, דהא א"ר אליעזר בפירקין לקמן (נזיר דף טז:) דאינו סותר [אלא שבעה]:
Tosafot on Nazir 14b:8:1.english: "In accordance with [whose opinion]? If in accordance with the opinion of Rabbi Eliezer, since he said shaving is indispensable to him" - [That is, indispensable from] drinking wine. “It is within the full term” — Meaning, it is as though he became impure prior to bringing his offerings, which is within the full term. “And let it negate” — Meaning, let him return and bring offerings [again], as we learned in a mishna in the chapter [entitled] “Sheloshah Minim” (below, Nazir 47a): “One on whose behalf the blood of one [of his offerings] was sprinkled and he became impure, Rabbi Eliezer says: It negates everything.” And the Gemara challenges: “But didn’t Rabbi Eliezer say: Any [impurity contracted] after the full term negates [only] seven [days]?” And [the Gemara] answers: “What is [meant by] ‘it negates’? His offerings; and after [he is purified], he shall bring his offerings [again].” And this “let it negate” here perforce does not specifically refer to [a case where] he became impure on the thirtieth day, for Rabbi Eliezer said in our chapter below (Nazir 16b) that he negates only seven [days].

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:8:2.hebrew: אלא אליבא דרבנן האמרי דתגלחת לא מיעכבא - לשתות ביין; וכיון שהביא קרבנות, מותר לטמאות ולשתות בלא תגלחת כלל:
Tosafot on Nazir 14b:8:2.english: "Rather, in accordance with the Rabbis — didn't they say that shaving is not indispensable" - [It does not prevent him from] drinking wine; and once he has brought [his] offerings, he is permitted to become impure and to drink without any shaving at all.

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:8:3.hebrew: לעולם אליבא דרבנן ומאי אין לו תקנה למצות גילוח - דכיון שהביא כבר קרבנותיו, שוב לא יביא, ונסתלק, ומיד מותר לשתות ביין בלא תגלחת כלל. ו״הכל מודים״ דקאמר רב חסדא — קאי אפלוגתא דרב ושמואל, דפליגי דנטמא ביום גידול שער אם סותר; והכא, דנטמא קודם תגלחת, מודים דאינו סותר, דהוי כמי שגילח כבר:
Tosafot on Nazir 14b:8:3.english: Actually, in accordance with the Rabbis, and what is "he has no remedy"? For the mitzvah of shaving - For since he has already brought his offerings, he does not bring [them] again, and he has departed [from his nazirite status], and immediately he is permitted to drink wine without any shaving at all. And [as for that which] Rav Ḥisda said, "All concede" — it refers to the dispute of Rav and Shmuel, who disagree [over whether one who] became impure on the day of hair growth negates [his days]; and here, where he became impure prior to shaving, they concede that he does not negate [them], for he is considered like one who has already shaved.

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:9:1.english: "A nazirite whose days are completed" - [One] who counted all the days of [his] naziriteship, and is standing on the day of bringing his offerings.

Tosafot on Nazir 14b:9:2.hebrew: לוקה על הטומאה - אם נטמא קודם הבאת קרבנותיו, אבל אינו סותר נזירות שמנה, אחר שכלו ימיו כבר. ונהי דאשכחן בפירקא דלקמן (נזיר דף טז.), ואייתי לעיל: "נטמא יום מאה ואחד סותר שלשים" — היינו דוקא יום ק"א, וגזרינן אטו יום שלשים, דהוי יום תגלחת דאורייתא, כדתנן פרק קמא (לעיל נזיר דף ה:); אבל ביום מאה ושנים אינו סותר, או ביום שלשים ואחד אינו סותר:
Tosafot on Nazir 14b:9:2.english: He is flogged for impurity - If he became impure prior to bringing his offerings; however, he does not forfeit the naziriteship that he counted, since his days have already concluded. And although we find in the chapter that follows (Nazir 16a) — and it was cited above — "[If] he became impure on the one hundred and first day, he forfeits thirty [days]," that is specifically day 101, and we decree [this] on account of the thirtieth day, which is the biblical day of shaving, as we learned in the first chapter (above, Nazir 5b); but on the one hundred and second day he does not forfeit [any days], or on the thirty-first day he does not forfeit [any days].
